name: qa-agent
description: QA workflows for Claude Code on any provider (GitLab, GitHub, Jira, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket): Playwright-BDD UI E2E, API & API integration tests with accessibility checks, bug filing, fix verification, MR/PR test impact, flaky triage, test healing, traceability, release readiness, load tests, CI setup.

gitlab_url.title: GitLab URL
gitlab_url.description: Only if you use GitLab: base URL without a trailing slash (https://gitlab.com, or your self-hosted URL)

gitlab_token.title: GitLab access token
gitlab_token.description: Only if you use GitLab (as tracker or code host): personal or project access token with the api scope. Leave empty otherwise. Stored in your system's secure credential store
